answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 13927 Country: India Title: In salat if we start with surah and we forget it or mistaken in reciting and we recite another surah, is it require sajdah sahv (remedial prostration)? Question: In salat if we start with surah and we forget it or mistaken in reciting and we recite another surah, is it require sajdah sahv (remedial prostration)? Answer ID: 13927 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1016/1016=M/1430) The sajdah sahv (remedial prostration) does not become wajib only committing mistake in qiraah (recitation of the Quran) or by forgetting a verse. But if one keeps quite equal to the time of reciting SaubhanAllah thrice after forgetting, he must perform sajdah sahv (remedial prostration). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
